parties.respondent: The State of West Bengal & Ors

summary: Jurisdiction under MSMED Act, 2006 s.18; 'any party' not restricted to registered supplier; registration under s.8 not mandatory precondition for dispute reference; objections relatable to jurisdiction and maintainability can be raised before arbitral tribunal; Silpi Industries and Mahakali Foods distinguished; referral under s.18 upheld; matter referred to larger bench for authoritative interpretation.
legal_provisions_cited: Kone Elevator India Pvt. Ltd. v. State of Tamil Nadu
final_judgment: Appeal referred to a larger bench; decision of High Court not disturbed; proceedings before Facilitation Council permitted to continue.
